Deployed v2.14.0 of the web app to production. It is live and healthy.

Timeline: build finished at 14:02, canary at 5 percent from 14:05, full rollout complete at 14:19 after the canary showed no change in error rate. Total about 17 minutes.

What shipped:
- New onboarding checklist (feature flag `onboarding_v2`, on for 100 percent of new signups)
- Fix for the Safari double-submit on the checkout form
- Dependency bumps: next 15.4.2, prisma 6.8.1

Post-deploy checks:
- `/healthz` returns 200 on all 6 instances
- Error rate 0.11 percent versus 0.12 percent before
- p95 latency 340 ms versus 352 ms before
- The Prisma bump ran its migration `20261110_add_index_events` in 3.2 seconds with no lock waits

Rollback plan if needed: `deploy rollback web --to v2.13.4` takes about 2 minutes. No database change needs reverting.

Watch for: Safari checkout conversion over the next hour. I set a Datadog monitor that pages if it drops below 2.1 percent. Nothing needed from you right now.
